title: Lessons on this device
description: Everything you're working on, kept in this browser. Open one to carry on with it; nothing is overwritten.
empty: No lessons on this device yet. Start one and it will show up here.

storageNote: These lessons live in this browser. Deleting one takes its version history with it, and clearing your browsing data removes them all, so save a lesson to the cloud to keep a copy off this device.
